Nothing has changed since we last spoke. Your order Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet.

I'm sorry again that this has taken longer than the dates we first gave you. The factory has finished building all the Magic M. 40T units, and they're due to leave the factory on November 12. Your order is set to ship to you in (address hidden) by November 30. We'll email you the tracking as soon as it ships.

You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
This isn't what I was promised I was promised that it was ship on November 1st now you're saying November 30th I need a free miner for the inconvenience
Handed to the team · A free unit is beyond the $50 limit and needs a person to decide. I told him onl

I asked the team about the free miner. They're offline right now and pick it up Monday at 10am ET. Their answer will come to (email hidden)

You're right to be upset. When you ordered, your Magic M. 40T was due to ship October 31. That date was missed, and we didn't keep you updated well enough. I'm sorry.

Our November 3 email about the delay came with a $50 code for a future order. If you can't find it, please check your junk or spam folder.

Your miner still ships to (address hidden) by November 30, and the tracking will be emailed to you when it does.
